subject: POC Access Win Plan — MAP checklist & peering runbook
messages:
From: Alex Roberts <alex@novamed.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah@novamed.io>
Date: 2026-08-31T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff & environment needs (MAP kickoff)

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — NovaMed is excited to run a focused 2-week POC to validate inference latency and cost on a representative workload (clinical-summarization). We want to align on the MAP so there are no surprises during the run. High level asks from our infra and security teams: 

- API key provisioning and a dev org invite (scoped read/write tokens)
- IP allowlist entries (we will provide our egress IPs; need your public endpoints)
- VPC peering guidance & sample template (we may request peering if we go beyond simple allowlist)
- SLA window / expected throttling behavior for burst traffic

Tentative POC window: Sept 7 — Sept 18. Target success criteria: mean p95 latency < 400ms for 512-token inputs and cost < $X per 1k tokens (we'll share baseline).

Can you send a short MAP with owners and dates? Also attaching our high-level requirements (nova_requirements.pdf). If you can include a short networking snippet we can hand to our cloud team that would speed approvals.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex Roberts
Sr. Platform PM, NovaMed
alex@novamed.io
+1 415-555-0127

Attachment: nova_requirements.pdf (summary, 2 pages)
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Roberts <alex@novamed.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & environment needs (MAP kickoff)

Hi Alex — great to hear, and thanks for the clear ask. I put together a single-tab MAP (attached) with owners, dates, and required artifacts. Highlights below so your team can action quickly: 

1) API keys / org access (owner: Monica)
  - Deliverable: scoped API key pair + invite to dev org (redwood-prod-sandbox)
  - ETA: 48 business hours after getting list of email addresses to invite

2) IP allowlist (owner: Marissa)
  - Deliverable: endpoint IP ranges and firewall guidance (stateless REST endpoints)
  - ETA: 2 business days after you send egress IP list

3) VPC peering (owner: Naomi)
  - Deliverable: sample peering template and required CIDR ranges; we will coordinate calendar window for network change with your infra team
  - Note: peering is optional for the first week; recommended if you plan sustained throughput > 300 req/s

4) Evaluation & success criteria (owner: Monica)
  - Deliverable: test corpus, runbook for traffic shaping, and acceptance checklist
  - ETA: Monica to share runbook and synthetic test harness by EOD tomorrow if you confirm corpus access

I attached MAP_NovaMed_v1.xlsx and a brief network-snippet.txt you can drop into an internal ticket for your cloud team. Proposed kickoff sync: Sept 3 at 10:00am PT to finalize invites and IPs. Does that work?

Next steps for you: reply with list of emails for org invite; attach egress IPs if you have them; confirm Sept 3 sync.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
monica@redwoodinference.com | +1 617-555-0199

Attachments: MAP_NovaMed_v1.xlsx (MAP tab, owners/dates), network-snippet.txt (peering checklist)

Thanks Monica — this is exactly what we needed. Quick answers:

- Invite list: alex@novamed.io, sarah@novamed.io, infra_lead@novamed.io
- Egress IPs (single region): 35.201.12.0/24, 35.201.13.0/24 (please confirm these are acceptable)
- We prefer starting with allowlist for week 1; if throughput targets trigger we will request peering on Sept 10
- DocuSign: I attached our standard SOW/POC appendix to speed legal if useful (we'll also sign an NDA if needed).

We can confirm Sept 3 sync — 10:00am PT works for Sarah and me.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alex

Subject: Fwd: POC kickoff & environment needs (MAP kickoff) — internal action items

Forwarding the thread from Alex at NovaMed. Key internal asks and owners (per MAP):

- Marissa: prepare IP endpoint ranges and a short firewall snippet for the cloud team (they provided 35.201.12.0/24, 35.201.13.0/24). Please confirm whether we want to publish an A-record or NAT egress ranges; include recommended TTL and any publicly-documented endpoints.

- Naomi: draft a minimal VPC peering template for GCP (customer may request peering on Sept 10). Include the peering acceptance steps, who signs the change, and rollback plan. Note: keep CIDR assumptions conservative.

- Ops: need an API key scoped to dev-sandbox role; I will create the invite once you confirm the exact email set (Alex/Sarah/infra_lead). Token TTL: set to 90 days; include instructions for rotation in the MAP.

- Also flagging this for Solutions Eng to produce a short synthetic harness that targets 512-token prompts (p95 target < 400ms). I will ask SE to join Sept 3 sync.

Please reply with quick confirmations by EOD so I can finalize the MAP spreadsheet for NovaMed.

Thanks — I'll own the broad timeline and runbook.

Monica
